preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string must contain only lowercase letters and spaces.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '12345' or c in 'bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxyz ' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain only the numbers 1-5 and lowercase consonants and spaces.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join('1' if c == 'a' else '2' if c == 'e' else '3' if c == 'i' else '4' if c == 'o' else '5' if c == 'u' else c for c in s)
postconditions.description: The output string must correctly replace all lowercase vowels with their corresponding numbers.
